notes.title: REDCON update 2.1
notes.content:
This minor update introduces [b]perk farming[/b] for players who have completed the entire game and continue with replays (referred to as [b]Plus Game Replays[/b]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24319866/84350fee10a38f83944c69eb98fe3bfa929b73ca.png[/img]

In Plus Game Replays, your chances of unlocking a new perk are the same as for a regular win but are significantly boosted when you [b]switch the flag[/b] from Imperial to Krux.

Happy farming!

notes.title: Major Update 2.0
notes.content:
The main new feature is the [b]World Map[/b], which allows you to replay levels throughout the campaign. For what it's worth, you can reunite the map under the Krux banner after completing the campaign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24319866/40673954a877b54828008e02ed7605fcf89395f1.png[/img]

[b]Graphics quality[/b] has been improved with sharper, clearer visuals and smoother animations. This update brings enhanced support for ultrawide screens and high refresh rates, driving animations from 40-120Hz based on your configuration.

Please note that this update is [b]not compatible with existing mods[/b] due to a new resource management system. However, the old version of REDCON is still available on Steam in the [i]legacy[/i] channel. Save files for the legacy and new versions are separate, so you can switch between both versions without losing progress.

We've also released a [b]REDCON Demo[/b] on Steam. The demo version is limited to [b]18 missions[/b], and if you decide to purchase the full game, you can continue your progress from the demo.

MOLON LABE!

P.S. You can now observe battles at [b]3x speed.[/b] Double-press [b]F[/b] to switch fast-forward from 2x to 3x.

notes.title: What's new in 1.3.0
notes.content:
You can play the campaign in EASY mode. EASY mode [b]removes credits[/b] and budget planning.

All unlocked Weapons and Utilities are available for placement [b]without purchase[/b], making the game far less challenging.

You will receive no online score and achievements in EASY mode.

notes.title: What's new in 1.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]French localization
[*]Nuclear Strike Call-in
[*]Keyboard shortcuts
[/list]

After three unsuccessful attempts at a mission, you can now call in a Nuclear Strike against the enemy fortress. Use them wisely, there are only three strikes available during the campaign.

We've added new keyboard shortcuts to navigate your rooms, focus fire all your weapons at a single target, fire a barrage, and switch between different fire modes and shell types. You can find more details in the Strategy Guide.
